notes.title: 2 years in: Reflection and Projection
notes.notes:
Wow we just hit the 2 year mark for this project getting funded on Kickstarter!! 🤯I thought this would be a good opportunity to reflect on how far we've come, as well as talk about a future release. 

Whereas the first year was largely spent building and refining much of the player mechanics and power-ups (perfecting things like the grapple and the 2 types of dashes), this second year saw a lot more construction of the playable spaces for those mechanics to live in. 

More specifically: we finished multiple Boss fights/encounters, redesigned and reformatted menus (the menu for the tarot card database is a thing of beauty I'll likely show you in its own update), made mini-levels, puzzles, and side-quests, the mechanics for all sorts of switches and trampolines and such, animations and cutscenes, not to mention all the actual level design and building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/bfefa3ca43dd6afb5ca04c65580a75ca8f59de91.jpg[/img]

I had two people ask me recently if I had an updated timeline for the Little Ghost release. My answer to them, which I realized I should share with you in one of these updates, was that I wasn't sure but wasn't really stressed about it. Development has been continuing in a way I'm really happy with, and since the progress is steady I don't see a reason to add a sense of urgency to the process. My concern is making the best game I possibly can, and I want to keep that as the highest priority. I work on this game nearly every day and again, I can see real progress and a world taking shape before my very eyes. I'm proud of the work I'm doing and truly excited to share it with you -- when the time is right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/3f73bb0243bf246950d6f5850ac19b053e271c1b.gif[/img]
[i]here's that same progress map, but with the original demo highlighted for scale[/i]

My only sense of disappointment is that I don't have a good way of sharing that progress with you. It has been my intention for a long time to release a playtester version or a giant addition/patch to the demo, but I have revised that plan for the best reasons possible! I'm working at such a pace building the new zones that I think it would be detrimental to the process to pause now. For example, if I release a patch update adding the first 2 bosses into the demo (which was my earliest plan) then I will have to redirect my attention to player feedback and potential bug fixes there. I just cant justify taking my attention away from new development to go backwards just yet. While it may disappoint a handful of folks to have to wait a little longer, I think you'll be very happy once you see the work that has been done. 

I am considering a potential future patch that could reveal the first 2/3rds of the game but that obviously comes with some similar concerns. For now I just want to keep the momentum that I have and I'll keep you posted where I land with that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/d73f7addd08d0cf8f942ecd58989fe2e16938db1.jpg[/img]

I'm happy to be going into the new year with a solid foundation and a real sense of satisfaction with the work. Let's make it a good one!

notes.title: Kickstarter Launch, Physical Tarot Cards, and Patch v3.2.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Kickstarter Launch:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=WN9HFjlVttc;full][/previewyoutube]
^Updated KS Launch Trailer^

Hello, I'm Alan- the primary developer + art director of Little Ghost, a 2D puzzle platformer with metroidvania-style exploration of interconnected levels. The game has a surreal, psychedelic, papercraft aesthetic and there is a 2+Hour free demo available now on Steam and Itchio. While the demo serves as a "Chapter One" release, it has long been my hope to be able to create and share with you the full Little Ghost experience that I've plotted out over the last few years: over 9 hours of gaming with lots of power-ups and 4 playable characters that can join your team. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aabbadessa/little-ghost-vision-of-a-surreal-paper-world]Please support the Kickstarter[/url] to make this vision a reality!


[h2]Physical Tarot Cards:[/h2]
In Little Ghost, one of the main collectables are Tarot Cards, many of which grant metroidvania-style Power-Ups.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/1173887ba6083bee9e71ca038dcc0c4d3a4f3eb3.png[/img]
As part of today's Kickstarter launch to fund the full game, we will be offering the full 78 in-game cards of Little Ghost as a physical Tarot Deck, beautifully printed, featuring illustrations by the incredible Eduardo Alexandrino. This campaign is the culmination of years of work and study, and I couldn't be more thrilled to share it with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/9163cb6cbe53c8fffacaa4fe1d176da03059afb8.png[/img]

The Tarot Deck will also come with a booklet, to serve as a guide in your readings, as well as building upon and enhancing your understanding of the Little Ghost game lore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/bab1226dcf84898e77720f9acceaf888ad36e351.jpg[/img]

Some scenes from the game translate almost directly to the cards that represent them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/d59698460b9914982dc809d72ed9273da4f89736.png[/img]


In addition to getting the full 78-card Tarot Deck,  you can get your favorite Little Ghost Tarot Card as a TShirt...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/dcadbcf41ce825883aab15b602bfa5edc4c0a350.jpg[/img]
...or a TankTop...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/0df3abb02b2e81f3944b4f9e071d893e64ffd829.jpg[/img]
...or as a poster print...

Please consider supporting the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aabbadessa/little-ghost-vision-of-a-surreal-paper-world]Kickstarter[/url] or streaming the game or leaving a review or sharing with friends you think would enjoy it. Really truly appreciate any and all help in this!

notes.title: v3.2 ~ Steam Achievements are here
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/924b787e797d0e4ee0a76ebb2002419ea25ebf1f.png[/img]
LITTLE GHOST STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS

[h3]There are [b]70 Achievements[/b] and they are [b]Exclusive to the Demo[/b]. 
I really wanted to drive home the idea that this demo can be treated as a full game in its own right.[/h3]

These achievements add a lot of fun new quests & challenges. Again, this demo is evolving and is a slice of something larger, but it is fully formed and makes a great 2 hour game experience on its own. Now that the platforming has been refined, I want to encourage exploration of the spaces by rewarding you for finding secrets. There are achievements inspired by indiedev champions Indie Game Collective & Indie World Order, one based on the posters done by Pedro Ferreyro, and some based on streamer playthrus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/762c8fca5ff701b88eda1e4b0ca69ff2362254b2.png[/img]

+Made the screaming baby less difficult for the purple key 💜(ufo/bookshelf)

+Made a drastic change to the blue key 👁️(rhino/comicbook) making it not only easier but also re-imagining how it can be most useful in directing players across the map  NOTE: You can still use old save files, whatever doors you've unlocked, stay unlocked. Any remaining locked doors on your save file will just be moved.

+Redesigned fireman/bucket quest to remove redundancy and back-tracking

notes.title: V3.0 ~ Redesigned Float Power & Cinematics drastically improve gameplay/playfeel
notes.notes:
We had the pleasure of seeing a bunch of streamers play our Halloween update, and in seeing them play, getting their feedback, we realized where there were opportunities to improve the game and one thing led to another. Like dominoes or a puzzle box, things started to fall into place. And the result is a really refined version of the game. If you've played before, please consider playing again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/5ae3d270a449b8590341d04a912c53a09d83b691.gif[/img]

Patch Notes:
We've been knee-deep in work on this. In it, 100% in it. The amount of stuff we've added in the few weeks since Halloween is staggering.

The first thing you'll notice in the update is the addition of [u][b]a multi-faceted float "meter"[/b][/u] based on @GeneralPedroArt who drew a glowing aura on Little Ghost.
We loved it & just had to add it to the game! And it looks amazing! Particles & animation that convey UI info with style. If it were just a visual pop it would still be cool, but it really does help the platforming by conveying essential data in the moment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/23ff17cba33843937bbefa5c2d9c297999e3e897.png[/img]

Speaking of particles, we also added particles on everyone's favorite unicorn heads as well as Checkpoints, Steam coming out of the steam pipes, and Confetti when you grab items.

The next big change you'll notice is the [u][b]addition of cinematic camera movements[/b][/u] that not only help define the scope of each "room" or challenge but also help you understand the lay of the land, which directions you can move in, what you need to pay attention to.

Up next we have the [u][b]new loop-a-song feature[/b][/u] and [u][b]full system volume controls[/b][/u] - both suggested/requested by @itsApollyon. Also updated mp3 player UI art (scroll arrows and BGs) and new/found mp3s now display in pink text color to highlight which ones you've found, which are the newest etc.

The [u][b]home menu music loop has been expanded from 50 secs to a 5 full minutes of evolving music[/b][/u] for all streamers sitting on that screen :)
Also added 6 new SFX & swapped the two Christopher North songs (since my fav song of his was too well hidden)

[u][b]We added a whopping 11 checkpoints[/b][/u], also a [i]million[/i] platforming tweaks including [u][b]custom HP damage values for each object/enemy[/b][/u] and [u][b]3 new secret passageways[/b][/u]!

Rearranged the space just outside the village (with the sweeping hamster npc) yet again & [u][b]completely redesigned the section between the first boss & the ufo - it's really cool now[/b][/u]. 

[u][b]There are 4 NPCs who either got added or expanded[/b][/u]: We added animation & SFX to that little bird in the tutorial, we added a gryphon to one of the houses in the village, and now you can speak to that cute cloud you can ride, as well as the giant ant queen!

[u][b]Remade a ton of the UI[/b][/u] (probably silly to list it all out) but it really does make a difference, both in the visual impact and the "readability" of how you're progressing and how the map is getting upgraded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/2e16ef74fb52adb752600a2a389b603cec91b58f.jpg[/img]

Last two things worth mentioning, we added alternates for float button; in addition to the E key, you can also use F or X.
And, I wont spoil it here, but we added some animation when you pick up the 4th tarot card and get the upgrade/power-up. Has a great SFX too!

Please go try these updates out, it really feels like this is the definitive version of the Little Ghost demo.

notes.title: Little Ghost - major Halloween 2.0 update !
notes.notes:
First off, before I say anything else, let me assure you that I did NOT intend for my Halloween Spooky Cute 2.0 update that I'm launching on the Full Moon to be exactly 666mb . . . I didn't intend it, but I'll sure take it! 😅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40177564/ac5d5a173172cd08d82509533055544467cd9414.png[/img]

Now, as to what makes this update so darn special is that it really has a different gamefeel -- it's faster, "gamier" if that's a thing, the controls feel so much more responsive, and I think it is more fun. What I'm unsure of - and what I'd love feedback on - is whether or not this change in the platforming makes the game harder or not. Please let me know, please enjoy your Spooky Season, and please share this game with anyone who you think might enjoy it!

notes.title: Version 1.4 now available
notes.notes:
A new HUD features a ton of additions to help players learn how to best use the ~float~ mechanic, to have a sense of how big the demo is, and to better locate themselves within that large map.

+ Added UI that reads like a Jetpack Fuel Gauge to display float time remaining

+ Added UI for Compass coordinates and Updated Map artwork to make navigation more intuitive

+ Adjusted how percentage of game completed is calculated to give a more accurate sense of how far into the game you are at any given point

+ Added Percentage of Demo Completed and Death Counter UI displays to show how well (and how poorly) the player is doing

| : |


New cover Artwork by @ArtsyAxolotl on Twitter


| : | 

Players were experiencing difficulty with the first two challenges (the fireman's bucket & the laser keys). I kept telling myself that having folks overcome the difficulty would make them stronger players or that they'd "get" the float mechanic more as they had to perfect its use. I now think that was the wrong move and so I rehauled the platforming in those two levels.

Fireman's Bucket:
I cut the number of falling platforms probably in half or more. Now the player has more time to get used to jumping vertically before they have to worry about falling.

Laser Keys:
Here too I tried to ease the difficulty curve with some major changes. I think I ended up removing 3 laser obstacles all together and added about 3 new platforms to give additional solid ground.

| : |

Lastly, I tweaked some other Platforming elements, changed/added some NPC dialogue, and added text to the Inventory Menus. 

| : |

I hope you enjoy the demo and I'd love to hear if these changes were helpful to you!
